fact: On 8 September 2026 the digital-transition ministry presented the first AI tools for administrations, including the Idarati AI assistant, a meeting-transcription assistant and a document suite on a sovereign AI marketplace, with a national software forge to share tools across administrations.
title: Maroc IA 2030 : JAZARI, data centers, IA souveraine... où en est concrètement la stratégie marocaine ?
